# apicp_account_token (Resource)

Mints an API bearer token for an `apicp_account`, scoped to the scopes you list. An admin can mint any scopes for any account; a reseller only for itself or its descendants, and never `*` or a scope it doesn't hold itself. The token value is returned once, at creation, and is kept (sensitive) in Terraform state - treat the state as a secret. **apicp has no way to list or revoke tokens**, so destroying this resource only removes it from state: the token stays valid on the server. It is also why there is no import. To rotate, replace the resource, then revoke the old token on apicp's side out of band. If the account has `apicp_totp` enabled, apicp requires a current `totp_code` to mint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apicp_account_token" "mail_only" {
  account_id = apicp_account.example.id
  label      = "mail automation"
  scopes     = ["mail:read", "mail:write"]
}

output "mail_token" {
  value     = apicp_account_token.mail_only.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) ID of the `apicp_account` the token belongs to. Changing this replaces the resource.
- `label` (String) Free-text name for the token. Changing this replaces the resource.
- `scopes` (Set of String) Scopes the token holds, e.g. `["mail:read", "mail:write"]`. Changing this replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `totp_code` (String, Sensitive) Current one-time code, needed only when the account has TOTP enabled. Codes expire in seconds, so this is only used at creation and is never re-checked.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The bearer token. Only available from the apply that created it.
